mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and this applies going forward without exception. Local testing is done with self-signed certificates. All connections use HTTPS, with no plaintext exception, since proper certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
